pitch: DiffKit is a fast, design-first GitHub client.
description: GitHub's daily surfaces, redrawn on GitHub's own API. A browser cache and a small change feed make it feel instant.

bands.name: What people use
bands.caption: Every screen, in the order someone meets them.

bands.name: What every screen shares
bands.caption: The frame, the conversation parts and the design system.

bands.name: What makes it fast
bands.caption: How GitHub data reaches a screen and stays fresh.

bands.name: What surrounds it
bands.caption: Running it without GitHub, shipping it, and leading people to it.

outside.name: OAuth and App install
outside.role: Sign-in and the GitHub App installation flow

outside.name: GraphQL API
outside.role: Page bundles, my-work search and timelines

outside.name: Webhooks
outside.role: Tell DiffKit when something changed, for repos with the GitHub App

outside.name: Workers
outside.role: One Worker serves the whole app, deployed with Void

outside.name: D1 database
outside.role: Sign-in tables and the short-lived change table

outside.name: KV
outside.role: Expiring keys: installation tokens, readable-repo lists, cron heartbeat

outside.name: R2 bucket
outside.role: Images and videos uploaded into comments

outside.name: IndexedDB
outside.role: The per-user query cache and the raw diff cache

outside.name: Cookies and localStorage
outside.role: Session and viewer hint cookies, themes, pinned repos, saved filters

tour.title: Sign in with GitHub
tour.text: You sign in with GitHub and pick the repos DiffKit may read. GitHub stays the source of truth.

tour.title: Your work, across repos
tour.text: A home summary, a keyboard inbox, and lists of the pull requests, reviews and issues that involve you.

tour.title: Inside a repository
tour.text: Every GitHub tab, redrawn: code, history, issues, Actions, releases and settings.

tour.title: Pull requests are the centre
tour.text: The PR page loads in one call. The review page streams the diff as it downloads.

tour.title: Shared by every screen
tour.text: One frame, one comments-and-timeline kit, and a 59-component design system.

tour.title: One road to GitHub
tour.text: Every screen asks through one layer of server functions that picks the right token.

tour.title: Why it feels instant
tour.text: Seen pages paint from a browser cache. Webhooks feed a change list that tabs poll every 15 s.

tour.title: Around the product
tour.text: A local fake GitHub for demos and tests. One Cloudflare Worker, with rollback.
